Chat: Sidney.|(She sizes you up.) Transfer.

OptionText: You look like you're waiting for someone.
Chat: I'm deciding if you're interesting.|(Long red hair. Gold eyes. Not smiling.)

OptionText: I'll walk past if this is a problem.
Chat: Then walk.|(She doesn't move out of the way.)
She lets the silence sit.|Most transfers talk too much. Point in your favor.
I know.|(Glance at the kit rope.) They always issue that.
Sidney.|(Offered late on purpose.)

OptionText: If this is a test, say so.
Chat: Everything here is a test.|(Slight tip of the head.) Some are just quieter.
One clean outcome.|(Eyes on the rope.) You bind me, or I bind you.

OptionText: Is that how introductions work here?
Chat: On empty paths? Yes.|(Almost a smile. Almost.)
You can try.|(She does not step aside.)
Then do it.|(She turns her wrists out. Waiting.)
Hold still.|(She takes the coil without asking again.)
Don't make me wait long.|(She stays on the path.)
Would it change the knots?|(Eyes bright.) Finish. Or don't waste my time.

…Do it then.|(She watches your hands.)
Remember that choice.|(Voice flat.) I will.
…Fine.|(She holds still for the knots.)
Then go.|(Still bound. Still watching.)
Not even.|(Soft.) Just unfinished.

OptionText: Thank you for not making this worse.
Chat: Don't thank me yet.|(Almost a smile.)
I know.|(She checks once more.)
You handed me the option.|(Calm.)

OptionText: Are you going to leave me?
Chat: No.|(She starts on the knots the other way.) Day one.
She takes her time on purpose.|Patience is part of it.
For what.|(Almost amused.) The lesson, or the release?
Don't get used to mercy.|(Turns your wrists free.)
That's day one.|(Rubs a wrist or watches yours.) Weekend isn't over.
You will.|(Certain.) Whether I'm kind depends on how you left things.
Good.|(Almost soft.) Neither will I.
She doesn't follow.|Go.
You first, transfer.|(Turns away first or lets you.)
